articles.title: Lisandro Martinez Manchester United outburst Q&A: Jason Wilcox, transfer strategy and what next?
articles.summary: Lisandro Martinez's explosive outburst in the aftermath of Man Utd's defeat in Madrid on Tuesday has placed the focus firmly on director of football Jason Wilcox and the club's hierarchy.
articles.body:
Following the 2-0 loss to Atletico, Martinez criticised the lack of summer investment in the squad, adding that he expected more from "upstairs".

Here, Sky Sports News reporters Rob Dorsett and Kaveh Solhekol answer all your questions on the situation.

'Wilcox retains the full support of his United bosses'

Is Jason Wilcox's position under threat?

Sky Sports News football correspondent Rob Dorsett:

"Jason Wilcox retains the full support of his Manchester United bosses, despite the personal criticism directed at him by Lisandro Martinez.

"The defender's comments reflect the frustrations of some significant sections of the Manchester United fan base, but it is clear that Wilcox is working to a carefully planned transfer strategy that has been sanctioned by the chief executive, Omar Berrada, and the club's co-owner Sir Jim Ratcliffe. While Wilcox is being criticised by groups of supporters and Martinez, his bosses are satisfied with the job he is doing.

"United's hierarchy is determined to stick to their strict spending plans, and will not repeat what they feel are mistakes of the past, where players who weren't key parts of the first team remained stuck on lucrative long contracts. The club's current financial situation dictates that it will take several transfer windows to overhaul the squad fully, and that is the project Wilcox is overseeing.

"The plan is based on much of the intelligence collated by the club's director of data and AI, Michael Sansoni. That data suggested two seasons ago that the best way for United to improve their immediate results was to score more goals - as a bigger priority than the need to concede fewer goals.

"That is why the focus of the 2025 summer transfer window was on strengthening attacking positions - in came Benjamin Sesko, Bryan Mbeumo and Matheus Cunha. In this summer's window, the focus switched to midfield, and United spent £158m on three central midfielders in Carlos Baleba, Andrey Santos and Youri Tielemans. All three of those players started the Champions League match in Madrid.

"United fans feel strongly that they are lacking a top-quality striker with more experience and a better goalscoring return than Sesko, and also that there has been a long-standing need to strengthen at left-back, with Luke Shaw the only recognised senior left-footed full-back. But United sources insist they simply don't have the resources to solve all of the squad weaknesses in one window. Despite record revenues of £678m in 2025/26, they also made a pre-tax loss of £47m.

"It is clear that the next two transfer windows will focus on strengthening United's defence, where Martinez's future will also be considered."

'One of Martinez's team-mates challenged him as they were getting on the plane back'

Who do you think Martinez's comments were directed at? [Chris]

"Well, they were clearly directed at, very personally, the director of football Jason Wilcox. But the impression I've got from the people I've been speaking to have suggested to me that there may be an ulterior motive there because Martinez hasn't particularly liked the message he's got back from Manchester United in terms of his contract being extended in the summer.

"But look, if it's a message to the fans, judging by the reaction to the stories I've put out today on social media, he's singing to the choir. The United fans will very much like what Martinez is saying.

"The fans will like that. A lot of fans appreciate that. What I can tell you is that some of his team-mates didn't like it and I can tell you for a fact that at least one of them challenged him as they were getting on the plane to come back from Spain last night because Martinez was suggesting that some of his team-mates aren't good enough and he'd like better replacements. They hadn't done good transfer business.

"I wonder what the three midfielders make of that. Baleba, Santos and Tielemans - Is he referring to them? You know, they'd all have questions to ask of him. There'll be some fallout from this for days to come. It's Michael Carrick's job to try and steady the ship and get them playing football and winning matches again."

"Martinez is just frustrated. He's been at the World Cup in the summer. He's played with Lionel Messi. He got to the World Cup final. He wants to be challenging for trophies at this stage of his career. And he's come back to Manchester United.

"And, they've lost at Hull, who are probably as good as them. Brighton are ahead of them, Brentford are a better side than they are at the moment. And he's showing his frustration."

'Why would players want to go to Manchester United?'

Were the club not able to invest heavily last summer because United spent a year with no European football and no domestic success, so their finances must have been stretched? [Jake]

Sky Sports News chief correspondent Kaveh Solhekol:

"According to United's accounts, they had record revenue, even though they weren't in Europe at all. Even though they went from having 30 home games at Old Trafford to only 20 because they got knocked out of both domestic cup competitions as well.

"So despite all that, despite the fact that they're not doing very well on the pitch, their revenues were still a record £678 million pounds.

"I think Martinez knows his history. He knows that historically Manchester United were probably the biggest club in the world along with Real Madrid and Barcelona and they could buy whatever they wanted to buy.

"So Alex Ferguson would just pick up the phone, pick the best players, Wayne Rooney, Rio Ferdinand, whoever it was, and they were desperate to play for Manchester United.

"That is not the case anymore. You speak to the top players, why would they want to go to Manchester United? They can get more wages at other clubs and they can also win trophies at other clubs. Two things that you're not as likely to get at United at the moment."

'Martinez has done Carrick a bit of a favour'

What will happen to Martinez now? Will he be fined, or even dropped? [Tom]

"I don't think he'll be dropped because Michael Carrick needs him. As Paul Merson said, this has probably done Carrick a bit of a favour.

"No win in five, two wins in nine all season and from Michael Carrick's perspective, he's got one of his key players coming out and saying 'the manager hasn't been backed enough, he hasn't got enough resources to make us competitive'.

"So I think Carrick won't be unhappy with it. The bosses will be. Jason Wilcox and Omar Berrada certainly will be and it remains to be seen whether he will be disciplined.

"I mean technically this is a breach of contract. Technically he could be punished for it, whether that's a fine or whatever. It will be interesting to see whether that's made public or not. It's bound to be a question that Michael Carrick gets asked about in the news conference later this week."

'United can't compete financially with the big guys'

"Man Utd tried to sign Antoine Semenyo, they tried to sign Elliot Anderson and as soon as the figures that Manchester City were prepared to pay for those players were put on the table to Manchester United, it was like 'we can't get anywhere near that'.

"That is the financial reality of where United are and I think there's a bit of a disparity in terms of where Manchester United were as one of, if not the biggest club in the world, and all the successes that they had and a fan base that got used to that.

"The fanbase now is quite understandably a little bit annoyed that that's not where Manchester United are now and they can't compete financially with the big guys."

'United's problem has been they're not making money from selling players'

Is Martinez right, did United spend significantly less than their rivals last summer? [Katie]

"Look at the total spend and what all the other clubs did. I don't think they spent massively less than their rivals. If you look at the headline figures, you'll think Manchester City spent more than £400m. United spent about £120m.

"But the big, big difference is that Manchester City make a lot of money from selling players. Chelsea make a lot of money from selling players.

"The problem at United has been that they're not making money from selling players because of past mistakes that have been made in the transfer market and because their academy does not produce the kind of players for a whole variety of reasons that the academies at Chelsea and Manchester City produce as well.

"So I don't think it's a case of United not spending any money at all. I think it's more complicated than that. It always is, isn't it?"

'United still have a number of players they need to move on'

Losing Casemiro was huge and we didn't replace him - do you think squad is weaker this season than last? [N47H]

"They did replace Casemiro. Casemiro left and Manchester United were left with one central midfield player in Kobbie Mainoo. They spent £156m on three central midfield players in Baleba, Santos and Tielemans.

"Baleba is an example that Manchester United would shout out and say, 'this is what we have to do, this is what we're trying to do. We were quoted £105m by Brighton the season before to sign him. We weren't prepared to pay that, we couldn't afford to pay that. We wait 12 months, we get him for £70m'. So they have strengthened that midfield.

"I think the squad is stronger, but they've still got a number of players they need to move on. And their strategy is very clear that they will try and strengthen, in the next transfer windows, the defence. And I totally understand the Manchester United supporters' frustration that they went into this season with one recognised senior left-back, Luke Shaw, with more games than they had last season.

"And given all of Luke Shaw's injury problems, there's a problem there. You've got Dorgu and Mazraoui are also injured, United haven't got a left back. It's a major problem for Michael Carrick.

"But the reality is United are not going to make the mistakes that they made in the past. They weren't going to buy a stop-gap left back to come in and cover any problems that Luke Shaw would have. And then be stuck with that left back on big wages when they buy what they would consider a better left back in the transfer windows to come.

"So they're interested in Lewis Hall, they're interested in Myles Lewis-Skelly. The hard facts are they couldn't afford them in the last transfer window. And they will try and go after that calibre of player again in the windows to come."

'United have made a lot of mistakes in the transfer window since Ferguson left'

Are Man Utd not the second highest net spenders in the last five years, second only to Chelsea? [Freshman Dan]

"Net spend? That may well be... But, you know, they've made a lot of mistakes in the transfer window since Sir Alex Ferguson left. Obviously, the people in charge now were trying to address those mistakes.

"But the bottom line is United are just not that special anymore. Ten years ago, they were the richest club in the world. They were at the top of the Deloitte Money League. Now they are eighth, miles behind Real Madrid and Barcelona. Ten, 20 years ago, United could compete to buy the best players in the world. That is just not the situation now.

"If you were one of the best players in the world, why would you go to Manchester United? And I think that is one of the reasons why Martinez is so frustrated."

How can the same players play so well at the end of last season be so poor at the start of this season? [Cahal Gilmore]

"That's a really good question. I don't have the answer to that. Michael Carrick probably doesn't have the answer to that. Look, the practicality is last season was a bit of a freak season for Manchester United.

"They were knocked out of the League Cup at the first stage. They were knocked out of the FA Cup very early. They didn't have European football. They only had the Premier League to focus on.

"And the fragility in their squad, the lack of depth in their squad was not exposed. It's as simple as that. We all knew that coming into this season, with European football back, with them hoping to make some cup runs, with more games, that was going to be difficult for them.

"And maybe that's what we're seeing the start of here. I mean, look, in any other game, Harry Maguire would have started last night, but he's 33 years old and they have to manage his minutes. He can't play Saturday, Wednesday, Saturday with a journey to Spain in between as well.

"So, he's probably been rested with Leeds United at the weekend in mind. But United made mistakes in defence. Defensively, it cost them the game. So, Carrick's absolutely right.

"It feels like United are trying to build something for the future, but it's going to be painful while they do so. And we're going to see all that pain on the pitch, unfortunately."

articles.title: Feyenoord - Como en directo | Última hora de Champions League en vivo hoy
articles.summary: FINAL DEL PARTIDO. No le dio tiempo al Como a tener una más y el Feyenoord se llevó la victoria (3-2) en un partido que se desató al final. Nuevo baló
articles.body:
Última hora del Feyenoord - Como en directo:

¡¡¡Muuuy buenas tardes y bienvenidos a todos y todas a la segunda jornada de la Champions League!!! Feyenoord y Como se enfrentan en De Kuip con dinámicas opuestas tras el primer partido que disputaron los dos equipos hace más de un mes.

Por un lado, el conjunto holandés sufrió una goleada (5-1) en su visita al Camp Nou , en el que sólo un gol de Sem Steijn pudo descontar los cinco del Barcelona . Esa derrota abultada le hace afrontar este encuentro en el puesto 33 de la tabla clasificatoria.

Enfrente, un Como que debutó en la máxima competición europea con un cómodo y convincente resultado (4-1) ante el Leipzig, en el que anotaron Baturina, Douvikas, Assane Diao y Perrone . El equipo de Cesc Fabregas está en la sexta posición tras este primer enfrentamiento.

Desde las 18.45 horas , Feyenoord y Como abren esta jornada de miércoles de Champions League en un partido que seguro nos deja detalles interesantes, y nosotros lo viviremos como siempre, aquí, en MARCA .

articles.title: Celades, entre el crecimiento innegable y la necesidad de resultados
articles.standfirst: El Cádiz empieza a parecerse al equipo que busca su entrenador, pero sigue en descenso y el fútbol vive de resultados
articles.summary: El Cádiz empieza a parecerse al equipo que busca su entrenador, pero sigue en descenso y el fútbol vive de resultados
articles.body: Celades vio cómo el Cádiz se soltaba ante el Leganés y, una semana después, se marchó con una derrota difícil de digerir ante el Sporting. Su equipo empieza a funcionar, eso es innegable, pero la clasificación sigue sin darle un respiro. Un incómodo lugar para el técnico y para el cuadro amarillo, que tiene motivos para creer y cada vez más necesidad de ganar. El 4-0 había devuelto la sonrisa al cadismo. Llegaron los goles, aparecieron las conexiones y una plantilla joven que enseñó buena parte de su talento. Pero estaba claro que no era realista esperar una fiesta cada domingo. Sí lo era pedir que, a nivel resultadístico, tuviera cierta continuidad. Ahí está parte de la frustración. Los amarillos hicieron cosas para ganar, pero también dejaron escapar ventajas por elegir mal cerca del área. Una conducción de más, un pase que no llega, una transición que pierde fuerza. Detalles que una plantilla todavía en construcción necesita aprender a resolver. Celades tampoco encontró soluciones desde el banquillo. Las sustituciones fueron restando presencia al equipo y el Sporting terminó más cómodo. Saber cuándo intervenir y cómo sostener los últimos minutos es otra asignatura pendiente. Todo eso merece revisión... y también merece perspectiva. El Cádiz está más organizado y empieza a reconocerse sobre el campo. La derrota no debería borrar esos avances, del mismo modo que la aclamada goleada ante el Leganés no había solucionado todos sus problemas. La afición necesita alegrías y el entrenador, puntos. Pero costaría justificar un volantazo (tal y como pide parte de la afición) cuando el equipo da señales de estar creciendo. Hay razones para tener paciencia con Celades. A él le toca conseguir que esa paciencia encuentre recompensa cuanto antes porque, eso sí, el fútbol vive de resultados.

articles.title: Why Martinez highlighted Manchester United’s woes in Madrid meltdown
articles.summary: Amid Premier and Champions League woes, Man United players and fans ponder how preseason optimism has turned to despair.
articles.body:
Manchester United’s season plunged to a new low on Tuesday.

A third-place finish last season after a late charge under manager Michael Carrick gave Manchester United fans reasons to dream of a bright 2026-27 campaign.

But just two months in, hopes of a title charge or a top-four finish seem out of reach, with United registering their worst start to a football season in 40 years.

Their latest defeat – a 2-0 reverse at Atletico Madrid in the Champions League – is the third in five winless matches, and promoted centre-back Lisandro Martinez to blast the club’s board for a lack of support for the squad.

So where did it all go wrong for Man United? Al Jazeera explains:

A shambolic start to the Premier League season

When United lost to newly-promoted Hull City on the opening day of the top-flight season, the humiliating result gave supporters a glimpse of the disaster that would follow.

Of their nine matches across all competitions to date, United have won just two: August’s come-from-behind victory at home over Ipswich Town in the league, and the Champions League thrashing of Azerbaijani club Sabah last month.

A controversial Manchester derby defeat to Man City left a bitter taste, but the team had no excuses when they suffered a third-round League Cup exit to fellow league side Brighton & Hove Albion.

Then came identical 1-1 draws with Fulham and Tottenham Hotspur, two teams that are in the relegation zone.

The issues in United’s squad spread across departments, with the team failing to show any real urgency.

Sitting in 12th place, United’s points tally of six is their lowest total after six games since 1986.

Under-fire Carrick has plenty to ponder in latest Man Utd mess

United avoided a crisis at Craven Cottage in their last league game before the extended international break with a draw, needing a late equaliser to avoid a third consecutive defeat.

That dispiriting performance drew harsh words from pundits and ex-players, including Gary Neville, who particularly criticised the team’s second-half effort, calling it “absolutely pathetic”.

United boss Carrick, though, struck a defiant tone , trying his best to silence the noise surrounding one of the biggest clubs in world football.

“It’s not been ideal. It was always going to come at some point, and it’s come at the start of the season,” Carrick said.

The doom and gloom continued when United blew a late lead against 10-man Tottenham to draw 1-1 at Old Trafford on Saturday.

Carrick’s men were booed off at half-time and at the end of the match after a Tottenham side that began the day bottom of the table dominated for large spells.

“Obviously, it hurts, you know, it hurts a lot,” said Carrick, addressing the boos.

“It’s not nice to go through, but sometimes you have to go through it. That’s how it is, you know. It’s coming from a good place, really, and so I understand it.”

The 45-year-old former United midfielder was expected to build on last season’s optimism during his spell as interim boss. But having hauled United from the wreckage of Ruben Amorim’s reign, Carrick is in danger of losing his way in his first season as permanent boss .

Did Man United’s board fall short in their summer signings?

In the summer transfer window, United brought in three talented midfielders: Carlos Baleba , Andrey Santos, and Youri Tielemans, as well as a backup goalkeeper, Karl Darlow. That cost them 155 million British pounds ($204m) and raised the question: should United have spent more?

The club’s decision not to buy an established left-back and a reliable striker left unresolved gaps in the squad, forcing the team to rely on makeshift options.

This was seemingly at the heart of Martinez’s Tuesday tirade in the Spanish capital.

“I expect more from our technical director [Jason Wilcox], I have to be honest, as players we have to do more. But it is also important when you make a strong squad to be ready for these kinds of nights,” the Argentina international defender said.

What woes surround JJ Gabriel at Man United?

Away from the first team, transfer mania made news in the youth setup, but for the wrong reasons.

JJ Gabriel, widely considered one of football’s most exciting youth prospects, said he wants to leave the club and handed in a letter of de-registration. However, British media reported the club has no intention of granting that request and is hopeful a resolution can be found.

Recipient of the Premier League under-18 player of the year award last term, the promising winger has since drawn the interest of Europe’s top clubs such as Barcelona, Paris Saint-Germain and Bayern Munich.

Off the pitch, Man United’s financial losses mount

Last month, United reported that their annual net loss increased by almost one third to 43 million pounds ($57m) despite record-breaking revenues.

The Old Trafford club reported 677.6 million pounds ($890.7m) in revenue in the year to June 30, up 1.7 percent.

However, the club announced a seventh straight annual loss after taxes as co-owner Jim Ratcliffe’s cuts to operating costs offset contractual payments to sacked manager Amorim and a big increase in loan repayments.

The club’s debt remains over one billion pounds ($1.3bn) despite record revenues that are unable to prevent losses at the UK football side.

British billionaire Ratcliffe has overseen wide-ranging, and often unpopular, cost-cutting measures, including widespread job cuts and increased ticket prices, after completing a deal to buy a minority stake in the club in February 2024.

Ratcliffe’s fallout with Man United’s fans

Away from football, Ratcliffe has also sparked controversy with his latest comments about immigration, which prompted Manchester United’s Muslim Supporters’ Club (MUMSC) to call for his resignation.

In February, the 73-year-old Ratcliffe said the United Kingdom had been “colonised by immigrants” and later apologised if he offended anyone. He doubled down on those comments in a BBC interview, saying the country “is on the slide” because of it.

The MUMSC condemned Ratcliffe’s words earlier in the year and once again spoke out against his latest comments, describing them as “deeply disappointing”.

It wasn’t the first time the United faithful expressed their frustration – before losing to Man City, fans protested against the current ownership with a banner that read “the way you treat us is a disgrace”.

articles.title: Lisandro Martinez interview: Jason Wilcox again the target in latest Man Utd fallout
articles.summary: Lisandro Martinez's explosive comments after Manchester United's Champions League defeat by Atletico Madrid turn the spotlight back on director of football Jason Wilcox.
articles.body:
It is almost 10 months since Jason Wilcox was in the line of fire when Ruben Amorim gave the explosive post-match news conference at Leeds that triggered his dismissal.

Amorim was furious Manchester United's director of football had subtly advised him to change tactics for the previous game against Wolves.

"I will do my job and every department, the scouting department, the sporting director, needs to do theirs," said Amorim.

Less than 24 hours after that chiding, Amorim was sacked, and the focus was on the part Wilcox played in that.

This time Lisandro Martinez was doing the firing and had a target in mind.

He might have got the job title slightly wrong, but there was no doubting who Martinez meant after the 2-0 loss to Atletico Madrid when he said: "I expect more from our technical director."

There is no doubting either that Martinez knew what he was saying.

Working as a post-match interviewer for US broadcaster CBS, legendary former United goalkeeper Peter Schmeichel tried to steer Martinez away from discussion about his old club's summer transfer window on four occasions. Each time, the Argentina defender refused to be deflected.

"We don't have the best squad at the moment compared to other top teams," said Martinez.

"I'm not going to close my mouth. We need more ambition. If we don't say the truth, nothing will change."

During the summer, BBC Sport was told by dressing room sources the club needed to sign more players than the three - Andrey Santos, Youri Tielemans, Carlos Baleba - who eventually arrived, and it was "fairly obvious" where they needed to be - left-back and striker.

Another source with extensive knowledge of the inner workings at Old Trafford describes the current situation as "a mess".

Man Utd defender Martinez issues scathing attack on board

Quiz: Do you remember the big names who took aim at football club chiefs?

Martinez said he felt it was important to speak out the way he did. Many United fans are delighted he went down that path, and the defender was highlighting inadequacies in the club's leadership structure.

However, there are a couple of other basic realities.

The first is that Martinez's contract expires at the end of the season. United have the option to extend it by another year.

By being so outspoken against senior figures at the club, was he trying to ensure that option is not triggered, which would allow him to leave for nothing in the summer, or, potentially, for a lower fee in January?

Martinez is good friends with Atletico Madrid defender Cristian Romero and the international colleagues spoke after last night's game. Romero was similarly forceful against the Tottenham hierarchy last season.

Also, while the vast majority of United fans may agree with Martinez, internally his comments create a problem.

Most obviously, head coach Michael Carrick, having deflected questions about the defender's outburst in the immediate aftermath of the game, will face more probing on the matter when he speaks to the media before Sunday's trip to Leeds.

Any players lined up to talk around the Elland Road trip will be similarly quizzed. When Tielemans was asked about it by Amazon Prime on Tuesday night, he replied with a "no comment". Given the comments about recruitment, he would clearly be within his rights to ask Martinez outright "did you mean me?"

Carrick has to manage the delicate dressing room dynamic at a point when he needs a collective focus on trying to win enough matches to keep him in a job.

Sources who know the United boss well are adamant there is no better person to handle the turmoil, and it is at times of crisis like this that his innate calmness is a major strength.

However, after five games without a win, it is a problem Carrick could do without.

Firstly, it must be pointed out Wilcox is going nowhere.

United sources say the 55-year-old is not in any danger of losing his job.

The club's recruitment department is working on potential targets for January given it is accepted the strategy of not signing left-back competition for Luke Shaw and striking support for Benjamin Sesko was flawed.

Both players have missed matches already this term, with Sesko sidelined for an indefinite period after suffering a recurrence of the shin issue that flared up in May and prevented him from playing any part in United's pre-season matches.

Unlike other major footballing countries on the continent, there is no expectation for sporting or technical directors to speak to the media.

Former United sporting director Dan Ashworth did it once during his five months at the club and was sitting alongside chief executive Omar Berrada.

Wilcox's only extensive interview since he was appointed in April 2024 has been with United's in-house media, when a couple of answers stood out.

"I am a coach at heart," said the former Blackburn Rovers and Leeds United winger, who spent several years working in coaching at Manchester City's academy.

"I am a coach inside, even though I know I have a different job now. That is a strength in my role, but it also causes me a bit of a problem because I always want to interfere in what the managers are doing."

Regarding his strategy for dealing with stress, Wilcox said: "My wife will know when I am bogged down with frustration. When I re-energise, I do it on my own. Me and the dog, walking."

Wilcox has only spoken briefly to the media after matches on a couple of occasions: after the 2-1 win at Crystal Palace last November, when he told journalists to "trust the process"; then again in Gothenburg after the pre-season encounter with Paris St-Germain when he enthused about the potential pairing of Tielemans and skipper Bruno Fernandes.

Recruitment was praised in summer 2025, when Senne Lammens was signed ahead of Emi Martinez, who was Amorim's preference, and Matheus Cunha and Bryan Mbeumo, plus Sesko, reinvigorated United's attack.

But the jury is out on the players acquired in the £155m summer outlay this year: Baleba, who missed the first six weeks of the season with injury; Santos, who has been an unused substitute in the last three Premier League games; and Tielemans, whose form has been patchy.

Sources have questioned the overall strategy, and specifically why Tielemans, who has a similar profile to England international Kobbie Mainoo, was signed, even for £35m, and if the £50m committed to Santos would have been better spent on someone who would be a first choice.

Trust is eroding among United fans over the minority ownership, agreed on Christmas Eve in 2023.

They might look at the other clubs where Ineos have an influence.

Nice are ninth in the French league and Lausanne-Sport are bottom in Switzerland. This doesn't generate a sense of a wider footballing vision that is paying dividends.

At Old Trafford, questions are being asked for the third season in a row over managers who were backed by the hierarchy in the summer. Erik ten Hag was sacked after nine Premier League games in 2024. Amorim went after 20 matches last season.

Minority owner Sir Jim Ratcliffe has also been blamed by fans for increasing ticket prices and launching what the club said was a ticket touting investigation among season ticket holders, but which supporters felt was an attempt to drive them out in favour of 'tourist' supporters.

In their latest set of accounts, United's overall debt stood at £1.1bn, with some fans criticising the decision to spend £63.5m on land for a new 100,000-capacity stadium - which is set to cost in excess of £2bn - rather than use the money to strengthen Carrick's squad.

articles.title: Libertad provisional para los cuatro ultras detenidos por la pelea cerca del Ciutat de València
articles.standfirst: Los detenidos, varones de edades entre 35 y 45 años, fueron detenidos como presuntos autores de los delitos de participación en riña tumultuaria y desórdenes públicos
articles.summary: Los detenidos, varones de edades entre 35 y 45 años, fueron detenidos como presuntos autores de los delitos de participación en riña tumultuaria y desórdenes públicos
articles.body: El juez de guardia de Valencia ha decretado la libertad provisional de los cuatro detenidos por los incidentes investigados inicialmente como un presunto delito de riña tumultuaria en las inmediaciones del Ciutat de València el pasado lunes, aunque deberán comparecer ante el juzgado cuando sean requeridos y comunicar cualquier cambio de domicilio, informaron fuentes judiciales. Agentes de la Policía Nacional detuvieron a cuatro ultras del Sevilla tras participar en una pelea con radicales del Levante horas antes del encuentro que enfrentó a ambos equipos en el estadio levantinista. Los detenidos, varones de edades entre 35 y 45 años, fueron detenidos como presuntos autores de los delitos de participación en riña tumultuaria y desórdenes públicos, informaron fuentes policiales, en una reyerta que se desarrolló en los aledaños del estadio Ciutat de València. Los hechos, que se registraron a las 12:30 horas del pasado lunes, se produjeron cuando un grupo de unos 50 aficionados radicales sevillistas se enfrentó a otro similar de seguidores ultras del Levante, muchos de ellos con palos y objetos contundentes, que se agredieron físicamente en una reyerta multitudinaria que causó daños en un comercio situado en las proximidades del estadio, informaron las mismas fuentes. Los cuatro investigados, que se han acogido a su derecho a no declarar, quedan en libertad mientras continúa la causa judicial, abierta en la plaza número 13 de la Sección de Instrucción del Tribunal de Instancia de Valencia. El magistrado ha ordenado además a la Policía que identifique al resto de personas implicadas en los incidentes, con el fin de avanzar en el esclarecimiento de los hechos.

articles.title: Fifa to offer extra £2.6bn for football development
articles.summary: Fifa is set to propose a $3.4bn increase in the amount of money it hands out for football development across the world.
articles.body:
Fifa is set to propose a $3.4bn (£2.6bn) increase in the amount of money it hands out for football development across the world.

World football's governing body wants to release the money from its reserves in a move which would more than double the level of planned distribution funding for 2027-2030.

It says it has been able to release the extra cash because of the commercial success of this summer's World Cup.

The proposal will be made at a meeting of Fifa's council on Thursday and comes at a time when the organisation is under pressure following president Gianni Infantino's aborted Fifa Forward Enterprise (FFE) plan.

Infantino wanted to sell stakes in the World Cup and other competitions to private investors but faced huge criticism for the proposal, with Uefa, Concacaf and the Asian Football Confederation questioning his position.

Uefa and Concacaf wrote to Infantino in September calling on Fifa to pay at least $10m (£7.5m) from its cash reserves to each of the 211 member associations.

In a letter then sent to Fifa's six continental confederations, Infantino - who will be standing for re-election for a fourth time in March 2027 - said he would support "the greatest level of additional funding that can responsibly be delivered".

Fifa will now offer extra money from its reserves in addition to the current $2.7bn (£2.05bn) budgeted to be paid to all 211 member associations, the confederations, regional associations and certain non-Fifa affiliated associations.

In total, Fifa will now be spending $6.35bn (£4.83bn) on football development for the 2027-2030 cycle, with a focus on investment and development of women's and youth football.

• $99m (£75m) for each of the six confederations

• $8.25m (£6.3m) for each of the 13 zonal/regional associations

• $1.1m (£836,000) for 100 member associations for travel and equipment solidarity

The terms of the distribution would be as follows:

• One third would be allocated to women's and youth football development

• One third would be allocated to infrastructure (of which there shall be equal access to women's and youth football)

• One third would be allocated to projects

The plan, including the eligibility, application, approval, disbursement, control and audit requirements, will be finalised by the Fifa council at its next meeting in December 2026.

It will all be subject to approval by the 77th Fifa congress in March 2027.

Proposed Fifa disciplinary code change over Balogun

BBC Sport understands there is a proposal on the table at the council to change the disciplinary code and prevent a repeat of the Folarin Balogun situation, an unprecedented scenario which meant the US striker did not miss a game after being sent off in the World Cup.

If approved, it will be expressly noted in the regulations that an automatic one-match ban for a red card cannot be suspended.

Questions have been raised over the process which led to Balogun having his ban suspended.

US President Donald Trump said he called Infantino to get the ban rescinded, which raised serious concerns over political interference.

A proposal has been put forward to add to Article 27 of the regulations a list of instances whereby a ban cannot be suspended.

This would include an automatic one-game ban for a red card.

articles.title: Pol Lozano: “Yo culparía a los jugadores, si ha de haber una cabeza de turco, somos nosotros”
articles.standfirst: El futbolista perico hacía autocrítica tras los últimos resultados del equipo y asumía la responsabilidad
articles.summary: El futbolista perico hacía autocrítica tras los últimos resultados del equipo y asumía la responsabilidad
articles.body: El Espanyol trabaja preparando el complicado encuentro de este semana ante el Atlético de Madrid. El conjunto perico se medirá a uno de los mejores equipos de la competición en el RCDE Stadium. Un duelo que no llega en el mejor momento para los de Manolo González, que no pasan por su mejor momento. Hoy, tras el entrenamiento matinal de los blanquiazules, Pol Lozano comparecía ante los medios para hacer autocrítica. El canterano perico analizaba el momento del club y asumía la responsabilidad por los resultados negativos del equipo, protegiendo a Manolo González de las críticas. Sobre el partido del equipo ante el Málaga: “En la primera parte hicimos lo que Manolo quiso, que fue apretar más, cuando tuviésemos la pelota tener más calma porque encontraríamos espacios. En la segunda había que continuar con lo de la primera y no lo hicimos. No fue una consigna suya defender más o echarnos atrás, pero por la situación en la que estábamos no estuvimos finos con pelota, intentamos defender para sacar los tres puntos y no pudo ser. No fue una cosa del míster, sino de que nosotros nos sentimos más seguros jugando de esta manera y nos equivocamos como se vio en el marcador. Jugando de otra manera podríamos haber ganado, pero el fútbol tiene estas cosas y los jugadores también nos equivocamos”. Un inicio de temporada con pocos minutos: “Los futbolistas siempre somos egoístas en el aspecto de que cuando no juegas, normalmente siempre lo pasas peor que cuando juegas. Lo que está claro que lo que nos va a llevar a nuestro objetivo es que el grupo está muy por encima de cualquier jugador. Se han hecho muy buenos partidos y minutos y cuando te toca participar menos lo único que puedes hacer es sumar dentro del equipo, seguir entrenando bien y cuando el míster lo crea conveniente estar preparado para poder sumar minutos de calidad”. Importante defender bien ante el Atlético de Madrid: “En Málaga nos empatan por una acción que la podemos defender mucho mejor, en Primera división eso te mata y más ante equipos así como el Atlético de Madrid que tiene mucho potencial ofensivo,. Si estamos sólidos y hacemos lo que hemos trabajado creo que vamos a sacar algo positivo seguro”. La portería y Fortuño: “Le conozco desde hace mucho años, sé como es él y lo que nos puede dar. Es un porterazo y tenía ganas también por él, de que lo pudiera demostrar y de que pudiera asomar la cabeza para demostrar el portero que es. Tiene una competencia muy dura y al final le va a venir bien también. Espero que siga creciendo como lo está haciendo”. Las dudas sobre Manolo: “La figura del entrenador es muy difícil y sobre todo cuando los resultados no acompañan. Si con el mismo juego estuviéramos ganando nadie diría nada del míster. A veces hay situaciones y cuando el equipo no termina de estar del todo bien, como ahora, las miradas es en el entrenador. Es una figura muy difícil, él sabe que no hemos hecho partidos al 100% de lo que podemos dar nosotros y nos exige mucho, en la intensidad e intentar hacer lo que él nos pide. La confianza nuestra hacia Manolo es grande. Llevamos muchos años con él, nos ha dado resultados y situaciones de juego que él nos enseña en los entrenamientos y después salen en el partido. Es normal que haya críticas, es el mundo del fútbol, pero si alguien se merece confianza es la figura del entrenador que tenemos”. Aspectos a mejorar: “Esto es lo que nos preguntamos siempre en el día a día y lo que intentamos conseguir. Son muchos pequeños detalles que a veces ganas y no sabes por qué y a veces pierdes o te empatan al final y analizas la jugada. Es muy evitable y son tres puntos que los sumabas el año pasado, por ejemplo, haciendo una falta en campo contrario. Son estos pequeños detalles que en Primera división si no lo haces no ganas. El año pasado estuvimos muy atentos en estos pequeños detalles. Lo que tenemos que hacer es recuperar la sensación de solidez. Son cosas que tenemos que controlar porque se nos exige en el día a día”. Necesidad de ganar en el RCDE Stadium: “Es muy importante porque todo lo que ganes en casa te va ayudar para ir fuera con más seguridad. Una de las cosas que debemos tener claras es que en casa tenemos que puntuar todos los partidos. Estamos mentalizados para ello y para ser el equipo que hemos sido. Tenemos que recuperar muchas cosas, pero las tenemos y para nosotros es primordial puntuar en casa”. Sentimiento por el club: “Cuando subes del fútbol base al primer equipo tienes esa sensación de devolverle al club la confianza que han tenido en ti. Esto lo sufres más cuando hay derrotas o no salen las cosas, pero hay que ser consciente que dentro del vestuario somos figuras que tenemos que enseñar a los que vienen de fuera lo que es el club y a la intensidad que toca jugar cada partido en casa con nuestra afición. En las derrotas lo pasamos peor porque sientes ese sentimiento hacia el club y eso es bueno”. Nervios por los resultados: “He vivido muchas cosas en el Espanyol y cada año son muy diferentes. Entiendo que la gente pida puntos. Lo que manda en el fútbol son los puntos y cuantos más tengas más tranquilidad para todo el mundo. Está bien, que se exija porque eso es bueno y que el objetivo del club es ir hacia arriba. Nosotros tenemos que ir acorde con eso y exigir puntuar mucho más de lo que estamos haciendo. Somos los primeros que lo exigimos. Ojalá ganáramos todos los partidos y nos duele no ganar”. Autocrítica por los resultados negativos: “Yo culparía a los jugadores. Al final somos nosotros los que jugamos y si hay alguna cabeza de turco que tiene que ser para el aficionado somos los jugadores. Somos los que tenemos que rendir y autoexigir. Así será siempre en el fútbol”. Adaptación de los últimos fichajes: “Si que han venido jugadores que tienen una base buena como Calatrava en la estructura. En el caso de Bryan Zaragoza, que vino casi sin hacer pretemporada, tiene que coger el ritmo poco a poco y ya nos está dando, pero nos dará muchísimo. Le conozco desde Granada y es muy diferencial. Pero hay jugadores que se tienen que adaptar y es normal. Ellos quieren adaptarse y ponen de su parte y eso es positivo. El objetivo es jugar y que se sientan cómodos. Poco a poco lo están haciendo”.

articles.title: Southeastern Conference Asserts in Court Filing That Its Dispute with LSU Has Not Been Resolved
articles.summary: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. (AP) — The Southeastern Conference says it has ongoing concerns about "a complete lack of institutional control" at LSU.
articles.body:
BIRMINGHAM, Ala. (AP) — The Southeastern Conference says it has ongoing concerns about "a complete lack of institutional control" at LSU.

The league levied the allegation In its latest federal court filing in a case that stemmed from the Tigers' since-abandoned effort to field football players who had tryouts or signed contracts with NFL clubs. A memorandum of opposition filed in U.S. District Court in Alabama on Tuesday came in response to Louisiana Attorney General Liz Murrill's motion to dismiss the case.

The SEC asserts that the dispute remains unresolved because of LSU's "ongoing defiance of the Conference's Professionalism Rules, and the very real threat -- reiterated in Defendants' briefing -- that Defendants will interfere with any effort to terminate LSU's membership in the Conference."

Although LSU's football roster never included players who'd spent parts of the past offseason with NFL clubs, basketball coach Will Wade has not yet committed to ending his effort to add RJ Luis, who spent part of 2025 NBA offseason and preseason with the Utah Jazz and Boston Celtics, to his roster.

Th SEC noted that LSU has "openly recruited" Luis and "allowed him to practice with LSU's men's basketball team, and has refused to publicly and definitively state that he will not be included on LSU's basketball roster," which is not due until the day before the Tigers' first regular-season game on Nov. 3.

The memorandum goes on to assert that "LSU has also recruited international professional basketball players whose eligibility remains in question. LSU's head men's basketball coach has been candid about LSU's strategy: 'We're going to be unapologetic about it. This is who we are. This is what we're doing. This is the path that we charted. We're going to go down it, and that's fine.'"

However, Wade did state during a press conference on Tuesday that he planned to follow "all SEC protocols" in regard to Luis.

Murrill responded to the SEC's latest arguments on social media, stating that the league's latest court filing proves that SEC Commissioner Greg Sankey "was never acting in good faith."

"LSU has broken no rules, and the case is moot," Murrill said. "The lawsuit was garbage from the start and should be dismissed."

The legal dispute arose when two of LSU football coach Lane Kiffin's former players at Mississippi — tight end Dae'Quan Wright and defensive tackle Zxavian Harris — arrived in Baton Rouge and began participating in team activities after being released by NFL clubs.

The two players were plaintiffs in a lawsuit initially filed against the NCAA by athletes who'd exhausted their eligibility at the end of the 2025-26 academic year, but argued they should receive one more year under newly adopted NCAA rules that went into effect last summer. Those rules allow all current college athletes to compete for five seasons in a five-year period.

Because of various injunctions issued against the NCAA in state courts around the country, a number of athletes in a number of sports have rejoined college teams and played this fall. But the SEC's own rules forbid football or basketball programs from having players who have joined NFL, NBA or WNBA teams. Those rules also include athletes who entered drafts for those leagues and never "properly" withdrew.

According to SEC policies, the league can oust members if the leaders of two-thirds of its member institutions vote to do so. While the league has yet to vote on LSU's membership, the memorandum stated that it "reserves the right" to do so, "if and when necessary."

articles.title: Antoine Semenyo: Manchester City forward ‘froze’ after alleged racial abuse by Liverpool fan, court hears
articles.summary: Antoine Semenyo was allegedly racially abused by a Liverpool fan while playing for Bournemouth at Anfield last August; the court heard Semenyo was left shocked and upset by the abuse; Mark Mogan, 47, denies racially aggravated behaviour
articles.body: Semenyo, who was then playing for Bournemouth, was allegedly racially abused by Mark Mogan, 47, as he went to take a throw-in about 30 minutes into the opening match of the Premier League season on August 15 last year. Simon Jones, prosecuting, told Liverpool Magistrates' Court on Wednesday the footballer saw Mogan, a wheelchair-user, to his right-hand side and heard him shout: "Hurry up and take the throw-in, you black b*****d." He said: "That racial abuse was shouted directly at Antoine Semenyo, who was close to him. Mr Semenyo briefly froze as he couldn't believe what the male had said." Mogan then shouted "I'm talking to you, you c***", the court heard. Mr Jones said: "He looked straight at Antoine Semenyo when directing this abuse to him. "Antoine Semenyo didn't say anything back to him and went to take the throw-in, however he was clearly hurt and upset with the racial abuse that had come his way." The footballer, who now plays for Manchester City, reported the incident to match referee Anthony Taylor when the ball next went out of play and Mogan was removed from the stadium at half time, the court was told. Two short video clips of the incident were shown to the court, in which Mr Jones said the defendant could be seen in an "agitated and angry state". He said witnesses saw Mogan take chewing gum from his mouth and throw it at Semenyo, striking him on the right side of his shorts. Mr Jones said: "We say that was plainly an unsavoury action from an angry man." In a statement read to the court, fellow Liverpool fan Neil Sherratt said he saw Mogan, who sits next to him at matches, leave his bay in the disabled section of the Main Stand and approach the pitch as Semenyo came to take the throw in. He said he heard Mogan shout something along the lines of "hurry up" and saw Semenyo turn towards him. He said: "Semenyo had a shocked look on his face and I believe he has replied back by saying 'you what'." Another fan, Nicholas Collins, said after the incident Mogan became "very cocky and brazen" and said: "If the bizzies (police) come I'm going to deck them. I'm not going anywhere." Mogan, who had an intermediary with him in court, was interviewed by police the following day and told officers he had shouted at Semenyo to "hurry up". "His account was that Antoine Semenyo called him a cripple which upset him," Mr Jones said. "He said he then threw some chewing gum onto the floor but not at Antoine Semenyo. "The prosecution say Mr Mogan clearly lied in that police interview." Semenyo is expected to give evidence over a videolink on Wednesday afternoon. Mogan, of Templehill Close, Dovecot, denies racially aggravated behaviour.

articles.title: Betis - Porto en directo | Última hora de Champions League en vivo hoy
articles.summary: Diez minutos para que arranque el partidazo en La Cartuja Pellegrini: El Oporto está acostumbrado a jugar la Champions. Pude enfrentarme con el Málaga
articles.body:
Última hora del Betis - Oporto, en directo

El regreso a la Champions más de 20 años después de la que hasta la fecha era su primera y única participación en el torneo no pudo ser mejor para el Betis . El equipo de Pellegrini ganó en Francia al Lille , remontando hasta en dos ocasiones un marcador adverso. Ahora, la exigencia se traslada a La Cartuja , su nueva casa, y donde esta noche volverá a sonar la música...

El 6 de diciembre del año 2005 fue la última vez que la afición verdiblanca pudo vivir en encuentro de la Liga de Campeones . El rival fue el Anderlecht . En esta ocasión será otro de los históricos del fútbol continental, el Oporto , quien visite Sevilla. El escenario en esta ocasión no será el Villamarín sino un estadio de La Cartuja convertido en fortín para los de Pellegrini ... y que también trae muy buenos recuerdos al club portugués.

Allí fue donde los Dragones conquistaron en 2003 la Copa de la UEFA frente al Celtic , uno de sus títulos continentales. Esta vez llegan necesitados tras caer en Do Dragao en la primera fecha ante el Manchester City . Aunque el potencial de su plantilla es enorme, con futbolistas como Froholdt , Samu , ya recuperado, o Gabri Veiga , y su arranque de liga en Portugal, perfecto: ocho victorias en ocho partidos. Pero enfrente tendrá un adversario ambicioso...

Alineaciones probables del Betis - Oporto

El Betis no se conforma con ser un invitado más a esta Champions y sueña con llegar lejos. Hoy podrá contar con Antony , superados sus problemas musculares, y aunque lo más probable es que Pellegrini rote en algunos puestos, con opciones de jugar para futbolistas como Bartra , Facundo Bernal , Ceballos o Troy Parrott , todas las miradas estarán de nuevo en su capitán, Isco Alarcón , cinco veces ganador de la Champions y que quiere mostrar de verdiblanco su magia en el torneo.

¡¡¡ Muuuuuuuuuuy bueeeeeeeenas a tod@s !!!

articles.title: Ji-sung Eom racist abuse: Millwall boss Alex Neil criticised for stoppage comments
articles.summary: Anti-racism campaign group Kick It Out calls on managers to "set the tone" after Millwall boss Alex Neil criticises halting a game following an accusation of abuse.
articles.body:
Anti-racism campaign group Kick It Out has called on football managers to "set the tone" after Millwall boss Alex Neil criticised the decision to halt their game against Swansea City following an accusation of racist abuse.

Tuesday's Championship match was brought to a standstill for seven minutes, midway through the second half, after reports of discriminatory chants directed at Swansea substitute Ji-sung Eom, which the Metropolitan Police is investigating.

After the game, Neil told BBC Radio London : "It needs to get dealt with. [But] stopping the game doesn't deal with anything. All it does is kill the momentum."

A statement from Kick It Out said: "Player welfare should always take precedence over the momentum or flow of a match, and it's essential that managers and all leaders recognise this and set the tone with their language so that everyone can stand up to discrimination."

Police investigate alleged racial abuse of Swans' Eom

When he was alerted to the accusations, referee Edward Duckworth had lengthy discussions with both sets of coaches and paused the match while he waited to pass a message on to Millwall's safety officer.

Following the stoppage, an announcement was made over the speakers at The Den confirming there had been alleged chants of racism and that police were working to identify any offenders using CCTV.

"I understand, obviously, there's been an incident," Neil said. "That's not something I'm going to get involved in - that'll be for the authorities to deal with.

"But the fact that it stops the game, I just don't see the point.

"The referee was wanting to speak to whoever the safety officer is, and then when he spoke to him, it [the game] restarted.

"That's partly my frustration. I want to get the game restarted, I want to get the game played.

"I understand there's other things that are going on, but you're not dealing with it down there, are you? It's going to get dealt with after the event anyway."

After the match restarted, Millwall went on to concede a 90th-minute goal to lose 1-0.

"If we score, I probably don't feel this way, let's be honest," Neil added.

Kick It Out, which has campaigned for more than 30 years to eradicate racism from football, said it was disappointed to hear reports of racist abuse towards Eom.

"Both clubs have condemned the incident, and it's positive that Millwall and match officials followed the right protocols so that action can be taken to identify any individual responsible," the organisation said.

"In that moment, protocols are in place to help match and security officials respond appropriately.

"That ensures that players are protected and key details are captured so that accountability can follow, regardless of how long it takes."

Millwall stated they were "aware of an alleged, individual incident of discriminatory abuse towards a Swansea City player during the second half" of the game.

"The club operates a zero-tolerance policy towards any form of discriminatory abuse," a club statement said after the game.

"Any individual found to have engaged in such behaviour will face the strongest possible action."

Swansea City head coach Vitor Matos praised the referee and Millwall's club staff for their responses to the incident.

"The referee followed the protocol for these sort of situations, they did the right thing," he said.

"Millwall did the right thing by announcing there is no place for this sort of thing. I'm happy with how it was handled, but really sad that it happened."

articles.title: Vinicius se pierde el Clásico: cuatro partidos de sanción
articles.standfirst: El Comité de Disciplina le impone una dura sanción por su roja ante el Villarreal
articles.summary: El Comité de Disciplina le impone una dura sanción por su roja ante el Villarreal
articles.body: Vinicius no podrá jugar el Clásico ya que el Comité de Disciplina le ha impuesto cuatro partidos de sanción tras ver la roja en el partido del pasado sábado ante el Villarreal. El brasileño fue expulsado al tirar del pelo a Nathan Saliba en la jugada que acabaría en su gol que fue anulado posteriormente por este motivo. Se perderá los partidos ante Sevilla, Barcelona, Racing y Valencia. No volverá hasta después del parón de selecciones de noviembre. El colegiado del encuentro, Isidro Díaz de Mera, reflejó en el acta tanto el motivo de la roja como un episodio adicional ya con el jugador expulsado. Fue el VAR quien avisó al árbitro, que tras revisar la jugada cambió de criterio. El acta dice lo siguiente: "2 partidos de suspensión por producirse de manera violenta al margen del juego, no estando en posibilidad de disputar el balón o el juego detenido, con multa/s accesoria/as en aplicación del artículo 5. Y otra suspensión: 2 partidos de suspensión por protestas al/a la árbitro/a, principal, asistente o cuarto árbitro/a". Para la sanción ha jugado en contra del brasileño que el balón no estaba en disputa, de lo contrario podría haber sido un solo partido, pero es que además en el acta el colegiado refleja "actitud agresiva" del madridista y recalca que tuvo que ser sujetado por sus compañeros. Vinicius pidió después perdón a sus compañeros y a su afición por haber dejado a su equipo con diez jugadores a través de las redes sociales. El jugador se pierde el partido ante el Sevilla del próximo domingo a las 21.00 horas en el Bernabéu, el del Camp Nou del próximo domingo 25 de octubre a la misma hora, contra el Racing el 1 de enero y el 7 ante el Valencia, ambos lejos del Bernabéu. De esta forma, el extremo ya no volverá hasta después del próximo parón de selecciones, para el partido en casa ante el Celta el 22 de noviembre. El delantero no fue titular en el último partido ante el Villarreal, de regreso de los compromisos internacionales, y su puesto lo ocupó Diomande. DE OLIVEIRA DO NASCIMENTO, VINICIUS JOSÉ "VINI JR." (Real Madrid CF ) 2 partidos de suspensión por producirse de manera violenta al margen del juego., no estando en posibilidad de disputar el balón o el juego detenido, con multa/s accesoria/as en aplicación del artículo 52 CD.. (Artículo: 130.2) DE OLIVEIRA DO NASCIMENTO, VINICIUS JOSÉ "VINI JR." (Real Madrid CF ) 2 partidos de suspensión por protestas al/a la árbitro/a, principal, asistente o cuarto árbitro/a, con multa/s accesoria/as en aplicación del artículo 52 CD.. (Artículo: 127) Primero. - El Real Madrid Club de Fútbol señala en su escrito que existe un error material manifiesto, alegando que las imágenes aportadas acreditan que el jugador no llegó a tirar del pelo de su adversario, sino que se produjo un contacto accidental de su mano con el cabello y la cinta que este llevaba, en el transcurso de un forcejeo entre ambos futbolistas. Asimismo, argumenta que la acción se produjo durante una jugada en curso y que el futbolista tenía posibilidad de disputar el balón, como demostraría su posterior intervención en la jugada que finalizó en gol. Finalmente, respecto de la conducta posterior a la expulsión, el Club sostiene que las protestas del futbolista no pueden constituir una infracción autónoma ni justificar una agravación de la sanción. Segundo. - Constituye un criterio reiterado de este Comité de Disciplina el que la apreciación de un error material manifiesto en el acta arbitral exige la aportación de elementos de prueba que de forma inequívoca, más allá de toda duda razonable, acredite bien la inexistencia del hecho reflejado en el acta o bien su patente arbitrariedad. Tal reiterado criterio se fundamenta en los siguientes puntos: (i) En primer lugar el artículo 155 del Reglamento de Competiciones de la Real Federación Española de Fútbol (RFEF), el cual, en su primer párrafo, establece que “el árbitro es la autoridad deportiva única e inapelable, en el orden técnico, para dirigir los partidos”. Añade esta misma disposición que entre sus obligaciones está la de “amonestar o expulsar, según la importancia de la falta, a todo futbolista que observe conducta incorrecta o proceda de modo inconveniente y asimismo a entrenadores, auxiliares y demás personas reglamentariamente afectadas” (artículo 156, párrafo 2, apartado e)); así como la de “redactar de forma fiel, concisa, clara, objetiva y completa, el acta del encuentro, así como los informes ampliatorios que estime oportunos, remitiendo, con la mayor urgencia y por el procedimiento más rápido, una y otros, a las entidades y organismos competentes” (artículo 156, apartado b). Sobre el valor probatorio de estas actas, el artículo 27 del Código Disciplinario de la RFEF establece que las mismas “constituyen medio documental necesario en el conjunto de la prueba de las infracciones a las reglas y norma deportivas” (párrafo 1). Y añade que “en la apreciación de las infracciones referentes a la disciplina deportiva, las decisiones del árbitro sobre hechos relacionados con el juego son definitivas presumiéndose ciertas, salvo error material manifiesto” (párrafo 3). De este modo, las actas arbitrales gozan de una presunción de veracidad iuris tantum, que podrá ser, en consecuencia, desvirtuada cuando se pruebe la existencia de un error material manifiesto. (ii) En segundo lugar, la doctrina de los órganos disciplinarios de esta RFEF y del Tribunal Administrativo del Deporte (TAD) respaldan las anteriores afirmaciones. Todos ellos han resuelto de manera clara en diferentes Resoluciones la necesidad de que las pruebas aportadas demuestren de manera concluyente el error manifiesto del árbitro. Puede citarse en este sentido la Resolución del TAD de 29 de septiembre de 2017 (Expediente 302/2017), que afirmó que “cuando el referido artículo 27 del Código Disciplinario de la RFEF señala que las decisiones arbitrales sobre hechos relacionados con el juego son “definitivas presumiéndose ciertas, salvo error material manifiesto” está permitiendo que el principio de invariabilidad (“definitiva”) del que goza la decisión arbitral en favor de la seguridad jurídica, en este caso, de las Reglas del Juego, pueda sin embargo mitigarse cuando concurriese un “error material manifiesto”, en cuanto modalidad o subespecie del “error material”, es decir que se trate, como ha señalado el Tribunal Constitucional, cuando se ha referido a este término en las leyes procesales (Vid. Artículos 214.3 de la Ley de Enjuiciamiento Civil y 267.3 de la Ley Orgánica del Poder Judicial), de un error claro o patente, independientemente de toda opinión, valoración, interpretación o calificación jurídica que pueda hacerse”. (iii) Por último, de todo lo anterior resulta que, para atacar la veracidad de las decisiones consignadas en el acta arbitral, el recurrente debe proporcionar al órgano disciplinario pruebas adecuadas y suficientes para demostrar la existencia de “un error material manifiesto”. En este sentido, es también doctrina reiterada del TAD la que declara la plena validez de la prueba videográfica como instrumento probatorio apto para desvirtuar el contenido del acta arbitral. Por su parte, corresponde al Comité de Disciplina, la obligación de visionar y valorar el contenido de la grabación a fin de comprobar si el mismo se corresponde o no con las alegaciones del recurrente. En definitiva, sólo la prueba de un error material manifiesto quebraría la presunción de veracidad de la que goza el acta arbitral y permitiría dejar sin efecto la amonestación recurrida. Tercero. No concurre a juicio de este Comité de Disciplina ninguno de estos supuestos en el caso que nos ocupa, puesto que el Club alegante no aporta elemento probatorio alguno que pueda desvirtuar lo señalado en el acta arbitral. Antes al contrario, las imágenes resultan compatibles con el relato del colegiado, resultando inequívoco el tirón de pelo, sin que las consideraciones relativas a la posición de la mano, la disposición de los dedos o el carácter supuestamente accidental del contacto permitan constatar un error material manifiesto en los términos exigidos por el artículo 27.3 del Código Disciplinario. Por otra parte, la circunstancia de que el balón estuviera en juego, o de que el futbolista participara posteriormente en la misma jugada ofensiva, no determina por sí sola que, en el momento concreto en que se produjo la conducta sancionada, se encontrara en posibilidad de disputar el balón. El acta arbitral precisa expresamente que el tirón de pelo se produjo “sin estar el balón en disputa entre ellos”, circunstancia que, valorada conjuntamente con las imágenes, permite apreciar que la acción se desarrolló al margen de una disputa efectiva del balón. En consecuencia, este Comité considera procedente la aplicación del artículo 130.2 del Código Disciplinario, procediendo imponer la suspensión de dos partidos, mínimo previsto en el citado artículo. En relación con las alegaciones formuladas por el Club respecto a la conducta posterior a la expulsión, este Comité considera que los hechos consignados en el apartado “Otras incidencias” del acta arbitral constituyen una conducta autónoma y diferenciada de la que motivó la expulsión. Las imágenes permiten constatar que, una vez expulsado, protestó la decisión arbitral, dirigiéndose hacia el árbitro con actitud agresiva y teniendo que ser sujetado por sus compañeros. En base a ello, procede imponer una sanción de dos partidos de suspensión, en aplicación del artículo 127 del Código Disciplinario, mínimo previsto en el citado artículo. En virtud de cuanto antecede, este Comité de Disciplina acuerda: Imponer a Vinicius José de Oliveira do Nascimento la sanción de dos partidos de suspensión en aplicación del artículo 130.2 del Código Disciplinario de la RFEF, con las multas accesorias correspondientes Imponer a Vinicius José de Oliveira do Nascimento la sanción de dos partidos de suspensión en aplicación del artículo 127 del Código Disciplinario de la RFEF, con las multas accesorias correspondientes.

articles.title: Competición sí quita la amarilla a Konaté
articles.standfirst: El central deja de estar apercibido con cuatro tarjetas al estimar las alegaciones del Real Madrid
articles.summary: El central deja de estar apercibido con cuatro tarjetas al estimar las alegaciones del Real Madrid
articles.body: Ibrahima Konaté deja de estar apercibido al estimar el Comité de Competición las alegaciones del Real Madrid a la tarjeta amarilla que vio ante el Villarreal. El francés estaba con cuatro tarjetas apercibido y con riesgo de perderse el Clásico su veía la quinta tarjeta este próximo domingo ante el Sevilla. De esta forma, el defensa se queda con tres tarjetas. "En el minuto 81 el jugador (16) Ibrahima fue amonestado por el siguiente motivo: Por derribar a un contrario en la disputa del balón, cortando así su avance, evitando un ataque prometedor”, dice el Comité, que acepta después que las pruebas que aporta el Madrid demuestran que no hubo contacto suficiente", apunta el Comité, que después argumenta que las pruebas que aporta el Madrid dan la razón al club blanco. "Examinadas las alegaciones formuladas por el Real Madrid, así como la documentación videográfica aportada en apoyo de sus pretensiones, este Comité considera que procede estimar las mismas, al apreciarse la concurrencia de un error material manifiesto en la descripción de los hechos que motivaron la amonestación objeto de impugnación. En efecto, del visionado de las imágenes correspondientes a la acción controvertida se desprende que no existe contacto del jugador amonestado con el futbolista adversario, circunstancia que contradice el presupuesto fáctico sobre el que se fundamentó la decisión arbitral", sostiene el Comité.

articles.title: Loren Juarros se reencuentra con su modelo
articles.standfirst: El director deportivo malaguista se cruza con la Real Sociedad
articles.summary: El director deportivo malaguista se cruza con la Real Sociedad
articles.body: Loren Juarros vivirá un partido especial este fin de semana con la visita de la Real Sociedad a La Rosaleda. El club de la vida del director deportivo blanquiazul. Fue central en el equipo txuriurdin en la década de los 80 y 90. Disputó más de 300 partidos oficiales con la elástica donostiarra. Posteriormente, en diferentes etapas, fue director deportivo de la Real Sociedad. El tramo más largo al frente de la dirección deportiva se dio entre los años 2009 y 2018, llevando al equipo de Anoeta desde Segunda a la Champions League. Nombres como Illarramendi, Oyarzabal, Griezmann o Íñigo Martínez son algunos de los que surgieron, siendo el propio Loren Juarros el guardián del proyecto. Lo tuvo claro desde el primer día: el futuro del club debía nacer en casa. Con jugadores formados en el modelo de juego y en la cultura e idiosincrasia del club. Ahora, como máximo responsable de la parcela deportiva del Málaga CF, Juarros busca imitar el modelo que llevó a cabo en Zubieta en La Rosaleda. No es de extrañar que el Málaga sea, después del Athletic Club, el equipo que más jugadores de la casa tiene en sus filas, con un total de 16 en el primer equipo. El director deportivo burgalés mira en la Real Sociedad como quien mira en el espejo cuando reconstruye ese Málaga que cogió en Primera RFEF y que ha logrado llevar a Primera. No es la primera vez que Loren Juarros se reencuentra con la Real Sociedad en este proyecto. En su primer año en la capital de la Costa del Sol, el destino quiso cruzar a los dos equipos en la tercera ronda de la Copa del Rey. Un gol en propia puerta de Einar Galilea separó a los dos equipos en el marcador. El siguiente reencuentro llegaría la pasada temporada con los duelos ante el filial donostiarra. En La Rosaleda ganó el Málaga uno a cero y en Anoeta, los malacitanos perdieron dos a uno.

articles.title: Real Madrid’s Vinicius banned for Clasico after hair-pull red card
articles.summary: Vinicius will miss El Clasico on October 25 in his four-match ban for pulling Saliba’s hair in La Liga.
articles.body:
Real Madrid’s Vinicius Junior will miss the upcoming match against Barcelona in the Spanish league after being issued a four-match suspension for pulling an opponent’s hair during a La Liga game last week.

The Brazilian forward will miss Madrid’s next four league fixtures, including the highly anticipated October 25 El Clasico against fierce rivals and league champions Barcelona.

The Spanish federation’s disciplinary committee announced the ban on Wednesday after Vinicius received the red card against Villarreal last week.

The number seven thought he had scored Real’s second goal in the match on Saturday, but his effort was disallowed after a video assistant referee (VAR) review found he should be dismissed for pulling Nathan Saliba’s hair in the build-up.

The Spanish football federation’s disciplinary committee confirmed the Brazilian will be banned for several matches, including the visit to face league leaders Barca, because of both the red card and his subsequent protests.

After the match, Vinicius, ⁠⁠⁠⁠who came on in the ⁠⁠⁠⁠52nd minute and was red-carded 20 minutes later, posted on social media, saying, “sorry to the team and the ⁠⁠⁠⁠fans”.

Vinicius was celebrating after scoring when referee Isidro Diaz de Mera was called by the VAR to review the moments before his goal. The referee waved off the goal and pulled out a red card for Vinicius, who also goes by his nickname Vini Jr.

When he thought Vinicius had doubled the lead, Real manager Jose Mourinho ran to join the celebrations with his players.

But moments later, Vinicius was left livid by the referee’s decision. He screamed at Diaz de Mera while his teammates tried to calm him down as he left the field.

articles.title: Celta - Juventus | Aspas busca otra noche memorable: previa, análisis, pronóstico y predicción
articles.standfirst: El capitán está de vuelta frenta a la Juve
articles.summary: El capitán está de vuelta frenta a la Juve
articles.body: Europa brinda noches memorables. Es lo que espera revivir el Celta al reencontrarse con un adversario de prestigio que le trae los mejores recuerdos, un cuarto de siglo atrás. Entonces en la Copa de la UEFA, hoy en la Europa League, el duelo ante la Juventus es codearse con la nobleza continental. Este Celta no es el de entonces, que reunía estrellas lideradas por Mostovoi en el mejor equipo que el club vigués tuvo jamás. El Celta de Giráldez, con Aspas como abanderado, tiene mucho canterano y un mayor arraigo pero no con la calidad de antes. Además, no cuenta con algún jugador clave como Borja Iglesias, de nuevo lesionado. La Juve tampoco es la misma. El cuadro de Spalletti es irregular y lleva años sin dominar en Italia. En el Scudetto es sexto con tres triunfos, dos empates y una derrota. Llega además con bajas relevantes (Yildiz, Thuram y Locatelli). Al frente de los celestes estará el gran capitán, Iago Aspas, que ayer cargó de emotividad su regreso: “Siempre que estoy con el alta médica estoy disponible para jugar. Vamos un poco justos en cuanto a días pero yo si soy de la partida estaré igual de contento que si entro desde el banquillo. Lo que quiero es ganar como todos los celtistas y poder disfrutar de un partido precioso”. Por su parte, Giráldez mostró ilusión y confianza: “Es una muy buena prueba para nosotros. Está al 50%, tenemos recursos para poder ganar. Tenemos que confiar en nuestras posibilidades para poder hacerle frente a todo un equipazo como es la Juve”.

articles.title: Real Madrid's Vinicius Jr to miss Barcelona game because of four-game ban
articles.summary: Real Madrid forward Vinicius Jr will miss El Clasico against Barcelona after being given a four-game ban.
articles.body:
Real Madrid forward Vinicius Jr will miss El Clasico against Barcelona after being given a four-game ban.

The Brazil international was sent off for pulling Nathan Saliba's hair in Real's 1-0 win against Villarreal last Saturday.

His suspension means he will miss games against Sevilla (18 October), Barcelona (25 October), Racing Santander (1 November) and Valencia (7 November).

Vinicius Jr came on after 52 minutes against Villarreal and thought he had scored his side's second goal.

However, the referee reviewed the build-up on the pitchside monitor and, with Vinicius clearly being shown to have pulled Saliba's hair before scoring, sent him off and disallowed the goal.

The Spanish football federation's disciplinary committee suspended the winger for two games for "behaving violently ... (while) not being in a position to challenge for the ball" and a further two matches for "protests" to the officials.

Following the match, Real Madrid manager Jose Mourinho did not attend the post-match news conference.

Vinicius also later apologised when he posted a message on social media, saying he was "sorry to the team and the [Real Madrid] fans".

articles.title: El Rayo, sancionado con el cierre parcial de Vallecas y una multa de 6.000 euros
articles.standfirst: Debido a los incidentes que obligaron a suspender el partido ante el Athletic
articles.summary: Debido a los incidentes que obligaron a suspender el partido ante el Athletic
articles.body: El Comité de Disciplina de la Federación Española de Fútbol acordó este miércoles el "cierre parcial" del estadio de Vallecas por un partido, así como la imposición de una multa de 6.000 euros al Rayo Vallecano, por los incidentes ocurridos durante el encuentro que enfrentó al conjunto madrileño con el Athletic Club y que obligaron a suspenderlo transcurridos veinticinco minutos. "Declara al Rayo Vallecano de Madrid, S.A.D. responsable de una infracción grave de alteración del orden del encuentro, tipificada en el artículo 107.1, en relación con el artículo 15 del Código Disciplinario de la Real Federación Española de Fútbol, e imponerle una multa de 6.000 euros y la clausura parcial de sus instalaciones deportivas por un partido, limitada al fondo situado sobre la zona de vestuarios", señaló el Comité en un comunicado. En este sentido, el Comité de Disciplina requiere al club franjirrojo que, "con el fin de garantizar el estricto cumplimiento de la resolución", comunique en el plazo de veinticuatro horas los sectores que conforman el "fondo situado sobre la zona de vestuarios" desde los que se produjeron los lanzamientos. Asimismo, el comité federativo apercibió expresamente al Rayo Vallecano de "la clausura total de sus instalaciones deportivas en caso de reincidencia", de conformidad con el referido artículo 107.1 del Código Disciplinario. En relación con la reanudación del encuentro, decidió dar traslado al Juez Único de Competición, "en virtud de las competencias atribuidas a dicho órgano competicional en el artículo 56 de los Estatutos de la RFEF

articles.title: Raul Jimenez - Wolves' veteran striker to have knee surgery
articles.summary: Wolves' veteran striker Raul Jimenez is to have knee surgery - and is now expected to be out of action until January.
articles.body:
Wolves' veteran striker Raul Jimenez has been ruled out until January after being learning he needs surgery on his left knee.

The 35-year-old Mexico international has not responded as hoped to treatment for the medial collateral ligament injury he suffered in the EFL Cup defeat at Everton a month ago and will now have an operation later this week.

"Unfortunately Raul's injury has not responded as we expected," said Wolves director of performance Phil Hayward.

"Normally the ligament for a fairly low-grade injury would heal on its own, however this has not responded as we were expecting, and after regularly scanning for the last three weeks, the ligament is not healing in the anticipated way.

"So, he'll have the surgery on Friday in London, and then he'll have around three months of rehabilitation before he's ready to play again. "

There is, however, better news on three other injured Wolves players, Rodrigo Gomes (ankle), Bertrand Traore (hamstring) and Boubacar Traore (calf).

Wolves striker Jimenez to miss derby with West Brom

Hayward added: "Rodrigo Gomes is progressing well, but it's still early days. He injured a couple of ligaments in the ankle, so it wasn't a straightforward injury

"He's still waiting on the inflammation to settle, and then we'll start to build him up and get him back outside as soon as that's settled. It's not going to be a long-term one, so he should be back reasonably quickly.

"Bertrand Traore has had a hamstring issue. It's a fairly small injury, however it is in a particularly problematic part of the muscle, which can commonly recur if we're not careful. So, we have to respect that and take our time with it. But it's not a big injury, he's doing really well, working hard and won't be too long."

"Boubacar Traore has been out for a couple of weeks because of a problem with his calf. He's back on the pitch working with the rehab coaches and doing really well. He's progressing nicely and he'll be back in full training in the next week or two. He's responded really well to the treatment."

Wolves are ninth in the Championship table, outside the play-off places on goal difference only, and will be away to Burnley on Friday evening.
